name: Microgrid controller manual-mode interface
summary: Identifies the documented manual control authority and its assigned automatic restraints.
description: Identifies the documented manual control authority and its assigned automatic restraints. A microgrid operating-mode function coordinates how local sources and loads relate to the utility connection. The selected mode, the measured electrical condition and the actual switching configuration can differ during a transition.

In a microgrid serving a switchroom and industrial loads, the controller can move between grid-connected and islanded operating states only through its defined transition logic. Each state needs identifiable source roles and feedback. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Manual mode selection” at the input and “Manual-control state” at the output. Manual mode is not permission to defeat protection.
